name: linkedin-humanizer
description: Remove the AI tells human readers and LinkedIn's AI-slop filter react to in a post or comment: 2026 vocabulary by paragraph density, reveal bridges, staccato fragments, stacked triads, performed sincerity. Tiered rewriter (forensic / strict / aesthetic / all) plus `--mode audit` pass-fail review and `--mode profile` voice profile builder. Not for beating AI detectors (no edit reliably does). Keywords: humanize, de-AI, reads like ChatGPT, AI slop, scrub AI tells, review this draft, audit before p
author: sergebulaev
summary_zh: 用于识别并改写文章中的 AI 写作痕迹，适合发布 LinkedIn 帖子或评论前进行语气优化、审查和个人风格塑造。
